business_problem: Allianz Direct wanted to use generative AI to remove mundane contact-center tasks while keeping customer-service answers trustworthy, compliant and built on the same governed data platform the company already used.
solution_summary: Allianz Direct launched its first generative-AI customer-service workflow on the Databricks Data + AI Platform so contact-center agents could spend less time hunting through policy terms and more time helping customers. The team built a RAG-based agent-assist application that loads Allianz Direct's publicly shareable terms and conditions, retrieves the right passages for each policy question and presents grounded answers to a human agent rather than directly to the caller. Agent Bricks Custom Agents provides the core GenAI capability, Databricks Notebooks make workflow changes easy for developers, and Unity Catalog keeps the broader company data estate securely governed as more teams adopt self-service AI. Because the application runs on the same data and AI foundation Allianz Direct already used, the team could prototype quickly, test with a subset of agents and expand from the initial proof of concept toward broader rollouts and additional GenAI use cases.

data_flow: Publicly shareable policy terms and conditions are retrieved into a RAG workflow on Databricks, where Agent Bricks Custom Agents generates grounded responses for human contact-center agents. Developers update the workflow in Databricks Notebooks, and governed platform access remains controlled through Unity Catalog as the use case scales.
business_outcome: The new agent-assist workflow improved answer accuracy by 10 to 15%, built agent trust in the tool, reduced time spent searching across multiple systems and gave Allianz Direct a governed foundation for rolling out more GenAI use cases across contact centers.
